correctness.rationale: For every N>=2k+1, two pointwise stabilizers of at-most-k subsets generate the pointwise stabilizer of the intersection since their complements overlap. This yields the least support S of each quotient point, forcing its stabilizer to be a setwise stabilizer with some H<=S_t on S; hence all quotient orbits are Inj_t/H for t<=k. On each tuple equality type, equivariance forces the quotient map to select a fixed list of distinct coordinates modulo H. Identical coordinate recipes extend to arbitrary carrier sets, and pairwise equivalence to the original relation transfers via at most 2k atoms. The complement-support construction is equivalence on 2k atoms and nontransitive on 2k+1. No finite experiment substitutes for proof.
